title: deploymentFacts
responsibility: Formats full deployment identity and verified receipt facts.

inputs.name: deploymentFacts.deployment
inputs.description: Required deployment activity; only timestamps actually present are included.

inputs.name: receiptFacts.receipt
inputs.description: Required verified receipt with its full deployment id, address and optional verified time.

outputs.name: deploymentFacts
outputs.description: Ordered project, branch, full commit and present deployment timestamp facts.

outputs.name: receiptFacts
outputs.description: Ordered deployment id, address and present verified timestamp facts.

errors.name: Input access error
errors.description: Errors from supplied property getters propagate without cloning, serializing or replacing the input.
